architecture.mechanism: Heat dissipation through strategic material selection and thermal pathway optimization
architecture.intervention: Implement a multi-layered thermal interface material (TIM) system with phase change materials and graphite sheets between CPU and heat spreader, coupled with an anisotropic thermal conductor that directs heat laterally to the chassis edges
architecture.expected_effect: Reduces CPU package temperature by 8-12°C while maintaining external skin temperature below 44°C during sustained load
architecture.falsification_test: 30-minute stress test with thermal imaging monitoring CPU temperature and chassis skin temperature at multiple points
